description: Search PixInsight's built-in filter and camera QE database by name (case-insensitive substring). A grouped name also matches each name it stands for ("Sony IMX411/455/461/533/571" matches "IMX533"); results are ordered exact name, then substring, then grouped-name matches. Use it to pick exact names for run_spfc or run_spcc. Sensor QE curves have channel Q.

channel.description: Optional: R, G, B, L, PAN (multiband OSC) or Q (sensor QE)

name: find_filters
